# diagrid_pubsub (Resource)

Diagrid PubSub resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "diagrid_project" "example" {
  name = "example-project"
}

resource "diagrid_pubsub" "example" {
  project_name     = diagrid_project.example.name
  name             = "my-pubsub"
  component_name   = "my-pubsub-component"
  create_component = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component_name` (String) Component name
- `name` (String) PubSub name
- `project_name` (String) Project name

### Optional

- `create_component` (Boolean) Create component
- `scopes` (List of String) App IDs that can access this pubsub

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Status of the pubsub
